hints.title: Longest Non-Decreasing Subsequence
hints.text: Minimizing operations to make an array non-decreasing is equivalent to finding the length of its longest non-decreasing subsequence.

hints.title: DP State for Three Values
hints.text: Since array values only range from 1 to 3, track dp[v] as the minimum operations to make the prefix non-decreasing ending with value v.

hints.title: Prefix Minimum Transition
hints.text: For each element x and target value v from 1 to 3, dp[v] = min(dp[1..v]) + (1 if x does not equal v else 0).

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Constant-space dynamic programming over 3 group values.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Exponential search over all 3^n modifications times out.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize the equivalence to longest non-decreasing subsequence and solve in O(n) time.
